kali kali kali (gujarati).en: Sing in G (5 kattai). Major-pentatonic tune: G A B D E, no C or F#. 8-beat keherwa: count 1-2-3-4 at about 96 BPM.

belli bettadodeya (kannada).en: Sing in A (6 kattai). A natural-minor tune: A B C D E F G. 6-beat dadra: count 1-2 at about 66 BPM, each count split in three.

arivenum akakkan (tamil).en: Sing in D (2 kattai). The opening uses the folk raga Maand (a major scale); the verses move to Sarasangi, a major scale with a flat sixth (Bb). 8-beat keherwa: count 1-2-3-4 at about 104 BPM.

mother send your love to me.en: A Western-style song with no raga, in D major. Waltz time: count 1-2-3 at about 88 BPM.

ajnabi rah ke (hindi).en: Probably sung in Eb (2.5 kattai), with a bluesy scale that has both a major and a minor third. 7-beat rupak, grouped 3+2+2.

atulya tayute.en: Sing in C (1 kattai). A five-note minor scale: C Eb F Ab Bb, no D or G (the Malkauns sound).

tayendru azhaikkava (tamil).en: Sing in E (3 kattai). A major scale with a flat seventh (Mixolydian): E F# G# A B C# D. 8-beat adi tala: count 1-2-3-4 at about 84 BPM.
